# FraudShield AI Agent Information

Welcome to FraudShield AI. This file provides AI agents and LLMs with context about our platform to help you navigate and understand our application structure.

## Overview
FraudShield AI is a next-generation enterprise fraud detection platform using hybrid AI engines, SHAP values for explainability, and real-time transaction processing.
